Chat request with seed parameter for deterministic output; response includes system_fingerprint

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/liter-llm/packages/go"
)

func ptr[T any](value T) *T { return &value }
func main() {
	request := pkg.ChatCompletionRequest{
		Model: `gpt-4`,
		Seed:  ptr(int64(42)),
	}
		client, clientErr := pkg.CreateClient("your-api-key", nil, nil, nil, nil)
	if clientErr != nil {
		panic(clientErr)
	}
	defer client.Free()
	result, err := client.Chat(request)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Choices)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Choices[0].FinishReason)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.SystemFingerprint)
}
```
